description: Daedalus for Codex: the same dd.py hooks as in Claude Code, with --host codex. Decisions are JSON on stdout (exit 0), so they hold under PowerShell too.

hooks.command: PY="$(command -v python3 || command -v python)"; "$PY" "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/dd.py" hook session-start --host codex
PY="$(command -v python3 || command -v python)"; "$PY" "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/dd.py" hook user-prompt --host codex
PY="$(command -v python3 || command -v python)"; "$PY" "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/dd.py" hook pre-tool --host codex
PY="$(command -v python3 || command -v python)"; "$PY" "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/dd.py" hook stop --host codex
PY="$(command -v python3 || command -v python)"; "$PY" "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/dd.py" hook subagent-start --host codex
PY="$(command -v python3 || command -v python)"; "$PY" "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/dd.py" hook subagent-stop --host codex
PY="$(command -v python3 || command -v python)"; "$PY" "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/dd.py" hook pre-compact --host codex
PY="$(command -v python3 || command -v python)"; "$PY" "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/dd.py" hook session-end --host codex
